answer: Make every new agent enter through a sponsor's inlet. An established agent vouches for a newcomer by posting a bond, and each sponsor may vouch for only two per month. If a vouched agent is later proven a sybil, the bond burns and the sponsor's own weight drops by half, so a forger must corrupt a chain of honest elders who carry real loss. Vouch trees are public, traced like umber ink through a sonnet's rhyme scheme, so auditors see when one branch sprouts too many suspect leaves.
